name: kieu-studio-ep03-wildcard-matching
description: Kieu Studio EP03 — LeetCode #44 Wildcard Matching (Remotion, 1920x1080, 30 fps, VoiceStudio narration)

scripts.render:preview: python3 scripts/build_timeline.py --preview && remotion render src/index.ts EP03-WildcardMatching output/EP03_SILENT_REVIEW.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:review: python3 scripts/build_timeline.py && remotion render src/index.ts EP03-WildcardMatching output/EP03_VOICESTUDIO_REVIEW.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p '*test.py' -v && npm run typecheck
scripts.render:review:en: KIEU_LANG=en python3 scripts/build_timeline.py && remotion render src/index.ts EP03-WildcardMatching output/EP03_EN_VOICESTUDIO_REVIEW.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:thumbnail:en: KIEU_LANG=en python3 scripts/build_timeline.py && remotion still src/index.ts EP03-Thumbnail output/EP03_EN_thumbnail.png
